headline: Iran War Triggers Critical Helium Shortage, Threatening Global Semiconductor Production
summary: The ongoing conflict in Iran has directly caused a severe global shortage of helium, an indispensable inert gas for semiconductor manufacturing processes. This immediate supply disruption significantly threatens semiconductor fabs worldwide, leading to potential production delays, increased costs, and cascading impacts across AI infrastructure and other tech supply chains.
